name: Night Watch
summary: In Duskwood, the Night Watch holds Darkshire and the forest roads against rising threats. Abandoned by Stormwind's House of Nobles, the local volunteers face undead, feral worgen, and necromancy with Commander Althea Ebonlocke at their head. They depend heavily on travelers to defend their home.

sections.title: Abandoned by the Crown
sections.body: Stormwind withdrew its royal garrison after foul magic consumed the Grand Hamlet and changed the forest into Duskwood. King Varian Wrynn had disappeared, and the troops were recalled to the capital. Left without royal soldiers or supplies, Darkshire's townsfolk formed the Night Watch. They swore to defend Darkshire's borders against the horrors creeping out of the woods.

sections.title: A Frontline in the Mist
sections.body: From its headquarters in Darkshire, the Night Watch patrols roads buried in unnatural mist. Skeletal fiends and ghouls emerge from Raven Hill and Tranquil Gardens cemeteries, while feral worgen prowl Roland's Doom and Brightwood Grove. The militia is badly outnumbered and short of resources, and many of its finest defenders have fallen to threats such as Mor'Ladim, the wandering skeletal warrior.

sections.title: The Vigil of Commander Ebonlocke
sections.body: Commander Althea Ebonlocke, daughter of Darkshire's mayor, directs the defense with grim pragmatism. With no veteran reinforcements, she enlists capable travelers to thin skeletal legions, cull starving wolf packs, and investigate mysterious local murders. The Night Watch is the last barrier protecting human life in the region. If its lines break, Darkshire will fall into shadow.

faq.q: Why does Stormwind not send troops to help the Night Watch?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, Stormwind's House of Nobles is caught in political gridlock. The crown withdrew its garrisons, leaving Duskwood's people to defend themselves.

aliases: who is in charge of darkshire watch
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke leads the Night Watch from its office in Darkshire. She is the daughter of Mayor Lord Ello Ebonlocke and organizes road patrols, bounties, and defenses across Duskwood.

faq.q: What threats does the Night Watch fight most often?
faq.answer: The Night Watch most often faces risen undead from Tranquil Gardens Cemetery and Raven Hill, feral wolf packs, and worgen stalking Brightwood Grove and Roland's Doom.

faq.q: Who is Mor'Ladim, and why do the Watchers fear him?
faq.answer: Mor'Ladim is a powerful undead warrior who wanders Raven Hill Cemetery. He has slain several of the Night Watch's strongest patrols and is among the zone's deadliest threats.

faq.q: Are the Watchers professional soldiers or volunteers?
faq.answer: The Watchers are local volunteers: farmers, hunters, and townsfolk who took up weapons to survive. Local veterans trained them, but they lack formal military backing, royal equipment, and regular military wages.

faq.q: Where is the Night Watch headquarters located?
faq.answer: The Night Watch headquarters is in the heart of Darkshire. Commander Althea Ebonlocke and her officers plan patrols there and receive reports from sentries along the trails.

angles.text: As a human of the kingdom, you can see how Stormwind's noble court has left fellow citizens to face death in the shadows.
As an Alliance hero in Darkshire, you find a frontline community defending the border against nightmarish forces without official aid from the high command.
As a paladin, you can answer the Night Watch's desperate vigil with holy magic, shielding ordinary townsfolk from rampant necromancy.
As a warrior, you stand beside rugged militia members who face ghouls, giant spiders, and worgen with basic steel and raw grit.
